shared_elements: horizontal band of repeating geometric motifs
register-like division of the carved surface
monochrome stone surface with no paint or inlay
justification: Both surfaces show shallow, outline-based relief on coarse unworked stone in which a profile animal head sits adjacent to a horizontal band of repeated rectilinear motifs, which is the most specific correspondence. Otherwise they differ fundamentally in format and organisation: A is a low horizontal boulder with a single weathered, largely geometric composition, while B is an upright slab carrying several stacked registers of distinct animal figures rendered with crisper, more sculptural modelling.
